summary: PR 1094 is a verified partial fix: its focused regressions pass and it fixes the four named PR 1032 counterexamples, but the original repository-wide audit still fails with 38 sites and an independent Persimmon constructor probe demonstrates a live omitted lm_head prefix.

tests.what_was_measured: Reproduced the original failure with 53 quantization-aware constructor sites lacking an explicit prefix.
The same independent audit still found 38 sites, so the original contract remains unresolved.
The candidate's AST regression found explicit prefixes for all four named PR 1032 counterexamples.
18 tests and 42 subtests passed, including real Phi FP8 and ModelOpt resolver behavior.
ParallelLMHead received no prefix keyword for root and nested wrappers; nested expected nested.lm_head.

gpu_execution.evidence: The deterministic defect is source/configuration routing. One AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 was visible, but no affected model weights were available and no architecture execution was claimed.

remaining_counterexamples: python/sglang/srt/models/persimmon.py: ParallelLMHead omits lm_head prefix (independently reproduced at constructor boundary)
python/sglang/srt/models/persimmon.py: MLP and attention projections omit qualified prefixes
python/sglang/srt/models/voxtral.py: QKVParallelLinear and RowParallelLinear omit qualified prefixes
python/sglang/srt/models/falcon_h1.py: QKVParallelLinear and RowParallelLinear omit qualified prefixes
python/sglang/srt/models/hunyuan.py: FusedMoE experts and ParallelLMHead omit qualified prefixes
python/sglang/srt/models/gpt_j.py: RadixAttention and ParallelLMHead omit qualified prefixes

The independent broad audit reports 38 syntactic sites total at the candidate; some are literal quant_config=None false positives and the remainder require architecture-specific qualified-name validation.
remaining_limitations: No affected full-model weights were available, so no semantic, serving-path, or distributed validation was performed.
The available GPU is AMD gfx950 whereas the issue snapshot reported NVIDIA RTX 4090; the CPU-only routing failure is architecture-independent, but no cross-architecture numerical claim is made.
No native code changed in the candidate, so native rebuilding was not applicable.
